title: PAL Tool — Price Action Levels

edits.reason: Intro teaches PAL's DUAL purpose: it 'draws dynamic S/R levels from those formations' and is 'drawing the levels those formations create.' The def only draws the DBS support (77); no dynamic level is shown. The Big Red Circle (idx11, buyer exhaustion) sits at the ~99 peak and is exactly the formation that creates a dynamic resistance. yAxis 99 is at the band-top edge (band 77-99); pink = resistance per palette.

This is the worked trade. markPoints include a 'Target Achieved' EVENT pin (idx15) but the target PRICE is never drawn as a level. yAxis 119 = leg3 .to, inside band [77,119]; gold = take-profit target per palette. Entry is intentionally NOT given its own line — the long entry at idx8 fires right at the DBS Zone (77) which is already drawn, so a second line would be redundant.

notes: Both auditor gaps approved as-is (coordinates verified: introChart idx11=99 within band 77-99; lessonChart idx15=119 within band 77-119). No manual offsets needed. quiz.chart is correctly complete: pre-cut (cutIndex:9) shows only the DBS support level as decision context without spoiling, and the Red AP / Long Entry / Target outcome is properly routed to revealMarkPoints. revealMarkPoints supports only points (not markLines), so no target LEVEL line can be added there — the existing reveal pin is the right form. Nothing the auditor missed.
